# Task
Task: ajc-fbc
Title: Flat base change: close the three Cech obligations and the pullback exactness axiom leak
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge

CLOSE FLAT BASE CHANGE for higher direct images along a flat g. Roadmap AJC.fbc and AJC.cohomology. The global scaffolding (Cohomology/FlatBaseChange, FlatBaseChangeGlobal) and the affine termwise comparison are already sorry-free; all three remaining obligations live in Cohomology/CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean.

THE THREE DELIVERABLES.

 (1) FLAT PULLBACK PRESERVES FINITE LIMITS (AJC.fbc.exactness) — pullback_preservesFiniteLimits, CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean:162. THIS IS THE PRIORITY, and it is more than one leaf: it is one of only two sorry-bodied INSTANCES in the project that leak through typeclass synthesis, so it silently contaminates the axiom cleanliness of anything that synthesises it. Closing it is worth more than its line count suggests. Route: prove left exactness of Scheme.Modules.pullback for a flat morphism by reducing presheaf pullback to inverse image followed by flat extension of scalars. The blueprint frontier lists the supporting chain (presheaf inverse image is exact; inverse-image model of presheaf pullback; the underlying-abelian-sheaf functor preserves finite colimits) — those are unproved nodes with high unlock counts, so expect to build some of them.

 (2) PUSHFORWARD CECH BASE-CHANGE NATURALITY (AJC.fbc.cosimplicial.pushforward) — the remaining cech_pushforward_baseChange_natIso naturality square on cover-intersection restriction maps (:1634, with coverInterOpen_baseChange_eq at :639 and pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChange at :1588 in the same chain).

 (3) TWISTED CECH NERVE COMPATIBILITY (AJC.fbc.cosimplicial.twisted) — twisted_cech_nerve_iso (:1705) compatibility with cosimplicial faces on cover intersections.

MEASURE THE LEAK. Before and after, run scripts/axiom-frontier.lean and report what changes. A declaration that quantifies over the instance reports clean axioms as stated and only picks up sorryAx at a synthesis site — so measure at a synthesis site. If (1) lands, say explicitly which previously-contaminated declarations become genuinely clean; that is the headline of this task.

ALSO IN SCOPE, cheaply: the two sibling openImmersion_pushPull_essImage obligations (:1038, :1055) if they fall out of the same machinery.

DISCIPLINE. Search before proving — the sibling Rebuild has a 60-file Cohomology/ directory and a completed Cech port (roadmap AJCR.cech-port is done); check it before building anything from scratch. horizon search spans both projects and mathlib. Use the LSP loop between edits.
